limitations: Root multiplicity is over F2 for half the numerator, not an integral cyclotomic factorization.
No conclusion concerning open polynomial shape conjectures.
Possible unindexed equivalent formulations of the mod-four trace reduction remain an originality risk.
scientific_integrity: This is a coefficientwise polynomial congruence established from explicit generating functions and a parity calculation. Finite experiments are corroborative, not an infinite proof. Neither irreducibility nor coefficient unimodality is claimed.
title: A dyadic trace kernel for binary partition reciprocal numerators modulo four
